div.div:
Components:
• OpenTelemetry Collector - Central trace collector
• Jaeger Backend - Trace storage and query engine
• Trace Storage (Elasticsearch) - Persistent storage
• Jaeger UI - Web interface for trace visualization
Connections:
••• Red dashed lines = Trace export (async)
━━ Red solid lines = Data flow (sync)
All services export traces with order_id for tracking
